# Larder & Vine Win-Back Campaign (Launch Tue Jan 6, 2026)

**Key decisions**
- The manager's offer fails the finance ceiling, so each segment gets a reason-matched offer that costs **$18 or less per reactivated customer**.
- Segment D includes **Denver ZIPs only**.
- Every offer ends **Sun Jan 18, 11:59 p.m. local time**.

## 1. Audience Table

| Segment | Eligible email | Eligible SMS |
|---|---|---|
| A – Too expensive | 7,980 − 260 = **7,720** | **2,100** |
| B – Busy/travelling | 4,940 − 150 = **4,790** | **1,560** |
| C – Quality complaint | 1,710 − 90 = **1,620** | **380** |
| D – Moved (Denver only) | 248 Denver opt-ins − 0 suppressed = **248** | **52** |
| E – No reason | 3,060 − 75 = **2,985** | **680** |
| **Total** | **17,363** | **4,772** |

**Formulas**
- **Email:** Email opt-ins − suppressed. For segment D, only Denver-ZIP opt-ins are counted. All 40 suppressed D contacts are outside Denver, so none come off the 248.
- **SMS:** SMS opt-ins. No suppression is needed because SMS opt-ins are never on the suppression list. Segment D uses Denver ZIPs only (52).

The 797 non-Denver email opt-ins in segment D (757 after suppression) are **excluded** because they are still out of coverage.

## 2. Sequence Plan

- **Email:** all contacts receive E1, E2 and E3.
- **SMS:** SMS-eligible contacts also receive S1 and S2.
- **Scheduling:** all times are the recipient's local time.
- **Links:** each SMS link is 11 characters (`lrdr.vn/wbA` to `lrdr.vn/wbE`).
- **Character counts:** counts use the GSM-7 character set, which means no emoji and no curly quotes.

| Step | Day (date) | Channel | Segment | Window | Subject / SMS text (chars) | Preview text | Offer | CTA | Exit condition |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| E1-A | 0 (Tue 1/6) | Email | A | 10:00 a.m. | Your first box back is 25% off | Same favorites, smaller bill. Ends Jan 18. | 25% off 1st box | Claim 25% off | Reactivates, unsubscribes or hard-bounces |
| E1-B | 0 | Email | B | 10:00 a.m. | Dinner, minus the planning | Skip weeks anytime + free dessert on your first 4 boxes. | Free dessert, boxes 1–4 | Restart my plan | Same |
| E1-C | 0 | Email | C | 10:00 a.m. | We changed the menu. Taste it for $15 less | New recipes since September. See what's cooking. | $15 off 1st box | See the new menu | Same |
| E1-D | 0 | Email | D | 10:00 a.m. | Good news: we now deliver to Denver | Your first box back is 25% off. | 25% off 1st box | Order in Denver | Same |
| E1-E | 0 | Email | E | 10:00 a.m. | Your table's still set | Come back with 20% off your first box. | 20% off 1st box | Pick my meals | Same |
| S1-A | 2 (Thu 1/8) | SMS | A | 12:00 p.m. | Larder & Vine: We miss you! Take 25% off your first box back. Ends 1/18. lrdr.vn/wbA Reply STOP to opt out **(106)** | n/a | 25% off | Tap link | Reactivates or replies STOP |
| S1-B | 2 | SMS | B | 12:00 p.m. | Larder & Vine: Busy week? Skip or pause anytime. Come back for free dessert on your first 4 boxes. lrdr.vn/wbB Reply STOP to opt out **(132)** | n/a | Dessert ×4 | Tap link | Same |
| S1-C | 2 | SMS | C | 12:00 p.m. | Larder & Vine: Our menu is new since Sept. Taste the difference with $15 off your first box. lrdr.vn/wbC Reply STOP to opt out **(126)** | n/a | $15 off | Tap link | Same |
| S1-D | 2 | SMS | D | 12:00 p.m. | Larder & Vine now delivers to Denver! Get 25% off your first box. Ends 1/18. lrdr.vn/wbD Reply STOP to opt out **(110)** | n/a | 25% off | Tap link | Same |
| S1-E | 2 | SMS | E | 12:00 p.m. | Larder & Vine: Come back to dinner sorted. 20% off your first box, ends 1/18. lrdr.vn/wbE Reply STOP to opt out **(111)** | n/a | 20% off | Tap link | Same |
| E2 | 6 (Mon 1/12) | Email | A–E | 10:00 a.m. | Still thinking it over? | Segment's offer, e.g. "25% off your first box ends Jan 18." | Segment offer | Claim my offer | Reactivates, unsubscribes or hard-bounces |
| S2 | 9 (Thu 1/15) | SMS | A–E | 6:00 p.m. | Larder & Vine: Last call! Your comeback offer ends 11:59pm Sun 1/18. Claim it: lrdr.vn/wbX Reply STOP to opt out **(112)** | n/a | Segment offer | Tap link | Reactivates or replies STOP |
| E3 | 11 (Sat 1/17) | Email | A–E | 9:00 a.m. | Last chance: your offer ends tomorrow | Ends 11:59 p.m. Sunday. Your table's waiting. | Segment offer | Use it before it's gone | End of sequence |

## 3. Offer Table

Cost assumptions: the average first box is $64, and a dessert costs $3 per box. The ceiling is **$18 per reactivated customer**.

| Segment | Offer | Cost per reactivated customer | Passes ≤ $18? |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Manager proposal (all)** | 50% off 1st box + free dessert for life | $32 + $3 × boxes = $35 at box 1, $62 by box 10, unbounded | **Fail** |
| A – Too expensive | 25% off 1st box | 0.25 × $64 = **$16.00** | Pass |
| B – Busy | Free dessert on first 4 boxes (plus skip/pause messaging) | 4 × $3 = **$12.00** (maximum) | Pass |
| C – Quality | $15 off 1st box, framed around the new menu | **$15.00** | Pass |
| D – Denver | 25% off 1st box | **$16.00** | Pass |
| E – No reason | 20% off 1st box | 0.20 × $64 = **$12.80** | Pass |

- Each customer receives one code only, and codes cannot be combined with any other promotion.
- The manager's proposal fails on the first box alone, because 50% off is $32 against an $18 ceiling.
- For segment C, the "new recipes, complaints down 35%" proof point does the persuading rather than a deeper discount.

## 4. Forecast

**Reactivation formula:** (Email − SMS) × 2.1% + SMS × 3.4%

- Email-only contacts are forecast at the 2.1% email-only rate.
- SMS contacts are forecast at the 3.4% email-plus-SMS rate.

| Segment | Email-only | Email+SMS | Reactivations (calculation) | Rounded | Cost per customer | Incentive cost |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| A | 5,620 | 2,100 | 118.02 + 71.40 = 189.42 | 189 | $16.00 | $3,024.00 |
| B | 3,230 | 1,560 | 67.83 + 53.04 = 120.87 | 121 | $12.00 | $1,452.00 |
| C | 1,240 | 380 | 26.04 + 12.92 = 38.96 | 39 | $15.00 | $585.00 |
| D | 196 | 52 | 4.12 + 1.77 = 5.88 | 6 | $16.00 | $96.00 |
| E | 2,305 | 680 | 48.41 + 23.12 = 71.53 | 72 | $12.80 | $921.60 |
| **Total** | **12,591** | **4,772** | **426.66** | **427** | **$14.24 avg** | **$6,078.60** |

**Cost formulas**
- **Segment incentive cost:** rounded reactivations × cost per customer.
- **Total incentive cost:** Σ segment costs = $6,078.60.
- **Average cost per customer:** $6,078.60 ÷ 427 = $14.24.

Segment B's cost assumes all 4 dessert boxes are redeemed, so it is an upper bound. For comparison, the manager's offer would cost at least $35 × 427 = $14,945 on the first box alone.

## 5. QA Checklist

1. **Audience counts:** Apply global suppression and the Denver-ZIP filter for segment D before loading. Confirm 17,363 email and 4,772 SMS contacts, and confirm every SMS contact is also in the email audience.
2. **SMS timing:** Schedule SMS by recipient time zone (ET, CT, MT, PT) at 12:00 p.m. and 6:00 p.m. Throttle sends to finish by 8:30 p.m. local. Contacts with an unknown time zone should send on the Eastern schedule, which keeps every zone inside the 8 a.m.–9 p.m. window.
3. **SMS rendering:** Send each SMS variant to test phones. Confirm the brand name and "Reply STOP to opt out" appear, the message is 160 characters or fewer in GSM-7, and every short link resolves to the correct segment landing page.
4. **Offer codes:** Use one code per segment and make each code single-use and non-stackable. Set expiry to Jan 18, 11:59 p.m. local. Cap segment B's dessert at 4 boxes, and block codes for non-Denver segment D addresses at checkout.
5. **Exit triggers:** Sync reactivation status before every send so reactivated contacts leave the sequence. STOP replies end SMS only. Unsubscribes and hard bounces end email.
6. **Seeds and tracking:** Send seed tests of every email variant across major email clients. Tag UTMs by segment and step so results can be read against the 2.1% and 3.4% baselines.
